blocks.heading: One book, two inner books
blocks.body:
A map can point at another map. That inner file is still a table of contents. Call it a **nested booklet**.

A **keyscope** is a label on that nested booklet’s line. Inside that branch, `product-name` means this product. A sibling branch may reuse the same name for a different product.

One extra level. Draw it. If you cannot draw it, do not add more.

Without the label, two `keydef keys="product-name"` collide. One wins. A page can show the wrong pump.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **keyscope** :  a label on a nested booklet so the same name can mean two different things.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: Both products show the same name because the nested labels are missing, or you added extra nested levels you cannot explain.

Expected: Two nested booklets. Two different product-name values. The note says what each page showed.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Create maps/kp2.ditamap and maps/kp1.ditamap as nested booklets. Each one sets keys="product-name" to a different string (KP-2 vs KP-1).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: From the root booklet, point at each nested booklet. Set keyscope on each of those lines (for example keyscope="kp2" and keyscope="kp1"). If the label differs, write the label you see.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Put a small explaining page in each nested booklet that uses product-name. Open each with the root map set.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Write oxygen-bootcamp-work/week4/scope-note.txt: which value each page shows.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Do not add a third nested level. Do not merge this into flower-docs.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Run completeness on the root map.

blocks.summary: Two nested booklets. Two different product-name values. The note says what each page showed.

blocks.q: Two nested booklets both set product-name, and you did not label the branches. What happens?
options: The two strings join into one
One value wins. You may not notice in Author that the other product is wrong
Oxygen deletes the second nested booklet
blocks.why: Without a branch label, one name can only mean one thing. The other binding is lost.

blocks.q: Inside a labeled nested booklet, how do you write the product name on a page?
options: Just the name (product-name) :  the branch already applies
You must type the folder path every time
You cannot use a name inside a nested booklet
blocks.why: Inside that branch, the short name is enough.
